amendment_path: Human Director explicit decision, new version, never edit-in-place of ratified text

loop_closure.rescore_scheduled_at: when the subject is measured again
loop_closure.rule: implementation MUST refuse to emit a closed assessment without all three
loop_closure.the_miss: weakest dimension, stated with its score

verdict_enum.ABOVE_FLOOR: S >= floor AND no gate failed
verdict_enum.INCOMPLETE: missing required evidence or inputs (fail closed)

authority.ratification_reason: new governance instrument per 0001-GOVERNANCE-CONTRACT-V1; ratification of spec, seed rubrics, and each enforcement stage are separate decisions

definition.purity: pure function of (subject_sha256, rubric_id, rubric_version, canonical_context); same inputs -> byte-identical assessment

does_not: decide — it measures; decisions remain with the V2.1 Value Calculus and the Scorecard Law
replace the Scorecard Law's five steps — it mechanizes step 2 (SCORE)
replace tools/auto_merge_gate.py — the gate consumes assessments as evidence; the gate remains the merge authority
override hard boundaries — no score overrides safety, privacy, constitutional, or authority gates (SN-042)
gate production dispatch, production DB, credentials/money, destructive actions, or constitutional ratification — human-only regardless of score

future_gates: merges below floor do not merge
Smart App assemblies below 9 do not publish
Score stage of Smart App creation pipeline runs the Calculator by default
stage_rules: each stage entered only by explicit decision (scorecard + receipt)
no rubric gates production behavior before calibration history exists

stages.enforcement: informational; runs in CI + on demand; scores never block
stages.name: report_only

epistemic_state: CANDIDATE spec; implementation, calibration history, and enforcement stages are future work; reproducibility guarantee is a spec invariant to be proven by conformance tests
fail_closed: missing input, missing required evidence, unpinned rubric version, or missing loop-closure fields -> INCOMPLETE, no closed assessment emitted

rubric_version.rule: pinned version required; the value 'latest' is FORBIDDEN

math.gate_filter: failed gate on a dimension -> dimension contribution zeroed AND assessment.gate_failed = true; gates are hard stops, no score overrides
math.no_inference: no model inference inside scoring; AI judgment is frozen as evidence inputs before scoring runs
math.no_wallclock: no wall-clock reads inside scoring; timestamps are inputs
math.rounding: 2 decimal places at dimension level and aggregate; rounding rule is spec so implementations agree byte-for-byte

open_questions: first gate-wiring target: merges, Smart App assembly, or both

relationships.FULL-AUTO-MERGE-V1: gate consumes Calculator assessments as evidence
relationships.NAYA-DECISION-VALUE-CALCULUS-V2.1: shares value-function math; scores outputs, never selects actions
relationships.SCORECARD-LAW-V1: supreme; the Calculator executes its SCORE step
relationships.design_calculator.py: domain rubric plugin hosted by the Calculator, not a duplicate

rubrics.aggregation: weighted_score = SUM(w_i * s_i) after hard-gate filtering
rubrics.immutability: published rubrics are never edited; changes are new versions
rubrics.proposed_registry: BRAIN/01-GOVERNANCE/rubrics/ (open question: confirm no collision with another seat's registry)

ratification.CANDIDATE: usable for quality_check intents only; status visible in assessment

rubrics.schema: versioned JSON document with dimensions[].{id, name, weight, scale{min,max}, evidence_required, criteria, gates[]}

title: NAYA-CALCULATOR-V1 — the universal scoring machine
